messages:
Ravi: LAN night idea  anyone up for a mixed PC/console evening next Wed 7pm? Steam co-op + some Smash on the side.
Sofia: I'm in! I can bring my PC and a headset. Bringing Rocket League and Deep Rock too.
Chen: Count me in for Smash. I'll bring my Switch + adapter. Also can someone bring an extra controller cable?
Allegra: I have an extra USB-C to USB-A cable and a long ethernet. Happy to bring both.
Ravi: awesome. Quick poll: :one: Rocket League tourney, :two: DRG/L4D2 coop, :three: Smash free-for-all. React with a number.
Sofia: :one:
Chen: :three: but i'm flexible
Allegra: :two: then :three:
Ravi: leaning mixed schedule: start with coop, then tournament bracket for RL, then casual Smash. Start 19:00, finish ~23:00.
Sofia: snacks? I can grab chips + sodas. Any allergies?
Chen: Gluten-free option pls.
Allegra: I'll bring GF granola bars. Also a power strip.
Ravi: calendar-bot can you create an invite?
calendar-bot: Event created: "Midweek Game Night - Rocket League + Coop + Smash" Wednesday 19:00 Office Common Room  Attendees: Ravi, Sofia, Chen, Allegra.
Sofia: sweet. Reminder: no alcohol per office policy. See y'all there! :video_game:
